with date_bounds as (
    select min(created_date::date) as start_date, current_date as end_date
    from staging.stg_salesforce__opportunity
),
date_rows as (
    select unnest(generate_series(start_date, end_date, interval 1 day))::date as date_day
    from date_bounds
    where start_date is not null
)
select date_day,
       year(date_day) as year,
       quarter(date_day) as quarter,
       month(date_day) as month,
       week(date_day) as week,
       dayofweek(date_day) as day_of_week,
       dayofyear(date_day) as day_of_year
from date_rows
order by date_day

),

),
lead_converted as (
 select converted_date::date as date_day,count(*) as leads_converted from staging.stg_salesforce__lead
 where is_converted is true and converted_date is not null group by 1
),
opportunity_base as (
 select *,created_date::date as created_day,close_date::date as close_day,

 from staging.stg_salesforce__opportunity
),
opp_created as (
 select created_day as date_day,count(*) as opportunities_created,round(sum(amount)) as opportunities_created_amount
 from opportunity_base where created_day is not null group by 1
),

 select close_day as date_day,count(*) filter(where deal_status='Won') as opportunities_won,
 coalesce(round(sum(amount) filter(where deal_status='Won')),0) as opportunities_won_amount,

 round(sum(amount) filter(where deal_status='Lost')) as opportunities_lost_amount,

- name: salesforce__daily_activity
      description: Daily summary by date_day of leads created/converted, tasks/events counts, and opportunity creation/closure metrics with amounts rounded to 0 decimals.
      grain: One row per date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__lead
      - staging.stg_salesforce__task
      - staging.stg_salesforce__event
      - staging.stg_salesforce__opportunity
      - intermediate.int_salesforce__date_spine
      business_logic: '- Start from the date spine (one row per date_day); this drives the output. - Tasks: group tasks by the calendar day of activity_date; tasks_completed is the number of non-null task records on that day; tasks with a null activity_date do not contribute and will not join; no additional filters. - Events: define each event’s activity day as the calendar day of activity_date, otherwise the calendar day of activity_date_time; if both are null the event is excluded; events_completed is the number of non-null event records on that day. - Leads created: group leads by the calendar day of created_date; leads_created is the number of non-null lead records on that day; rows with a null created_date are excluded. - Leads converted: restrict to leads where is_converted is true; group by the calendar day of converted_date; leads_converted is the number of non-null lead records on that day; rows with a null converted_date are excluded. - Opportunities base: for each opportunity derive created_day from created_date and close_day from close_date; set status as: • Won when is_won is true • Lost when is_won is false and is_closed is true • Pipeline when not closed and forecast_category (case-insensitive) is one of pipeline, forecast, bestcase • Other otherwise Amount may be null and is used in sums. - Opportunities created (by created_day): • opportunities_created: number of non-null opportunity records • opportunities_created_amount: sum of amount rounded to 0 decimals; sums ignore null amounts and are null when all amounts are null - Opportunities closed (by close_day): • opportunities_won: number of opportunities with status Won; zero when there are close_day records but none Won; null when no close_day records • opportunities_won_amount: sum of amounts for status Won rounded to 0 decimals; zero when there are close_day records but none Won; null when no close_day records • opportunities_lost: number of opportunities with status Lost; zero when there are close_day records but none Lost; null when no close_day records • opportunities_lost_amount: sum of amounts for status Lost rounded to 0 decimals; null when there are close_day records but none Lost; null when no close_day records • pipeline_amount: sum of amounts for status Pipeline rounded to 0 decimals; null when there are close_day records but none Pipeline; null when no close_day records - Output: left join each aggregate to the date spine on date_day; if a date has no matching aggregate row, the corresponding fields remain null; no defaulting to zero beyond the rules above.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date from the date spine and join key; exactly one row per date_day.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: leads_created
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of leads created on date_day based on created_date; only non-null lead records counted; null when no leads match that day.
      - name: leads_converted
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of leads with is_converted=true whose converted_date falls on date_day; only non-null lead records counted; null when none match that day.
      - name: tasks_completed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of tasks whose activity_date falls on date_day; tasks with null activity_date are excluded; null when none match that day.
      - name: events_completed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of events by day using activity_date when present else activity_date_time; events with both timestamps null are excluded; null when none match that day.
      - name: opportunities_created
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of opportunities created on date_day (by created_date); only non-null records counted; null when none match that day.
      - name: opportunities_created_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of amounts for opportunities created on date_day, rounded to 0 decimals; null when all amounts are null or no records match that day.
      - name: opportunities_won
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of opportunities with close_date on date_day and status Won; zero when close_date records exist but none Won; null when no close_date records.
      - name: opportunities_won_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of amounts for opportunities with close_date on date_day and status Won, rounded to 0 decimals; zero when close_date records exist but none Won; null when no close_date records.
      - name: opportunities_lost
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of opportunities with close_date on date_day and status Lost; zero when close_date records exist but none Lost; null when no close_date records.
      - name: opportunities_lost_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of amounts for opportunities with close_date on date_day and status Lost, rounded to 0 decimals; null when close_date records exist but none Lost or when no close_date records.
      - name: pipeline_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,0)
        description: Sum of amounts for opportunities with close_date on date_day and status Pipeline, rounded to 0 decimals; null when close_date records exist but none Pipeline or when no close_date records.

- name: salesforce__sales_snapshot
      description: Daily sales snapshot computed at run time with aggregated opportunity, lead, account, and user KPIs
      grain: One row per snapshot_date (current_date at execution)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__opportunity
      - staging.stg_salesforce__lead
      - staging.stg_salesforce__account
      - staging.stg_salesforce__user
      business_logic: 'Snapshot context: - Set snapshot_date to the execution date. - Set current_month_start to the first calendar day of the current month. - Set current_quarter_start to the first calendar day of the current quarter. - Set current_year_start to the first calendar day of the current year. Opportunity metrics (from opportunities excluding deleted records): - total_opportunities: count of all rows. - won_opportunities: count of rows marked won. - lost_opportunities: count of rows closed and not won. - open_opportunities: count of rows not closed. - total_opportunity_value: sum of amount across all rows. - won_amount: sum of amount for won rows; non-matching rows contribute 0. - lost_amount: sum of amount for closed-not-won rows; non-matching rows contribute 0. - pipeline_amount: sum of amount for open (not closed) rows; non-matching rows contribute 0. - avg_days_to_close: average days_to_close over closed rows; ignores missing values. - avg_won_deal_size: average amount over won rows; ignores missing values. - opportunities_created_this_month: count of rows created this month. - opportunities_created_this_quarter: count of rows created this quarter. - opportunities_won_this_month: count of rows both won and closed this month. - opportunities_won_this_quarter: count of rows both won and closed this quarter. - pipeline_created_this_month: sum of amount for rows created this month; non-matching rows contribute 0. - pipeline_created_this_quarter: sum of amount for rows created this quarter; non-matching rows contribute 0. - revenue_this_month: sum of amount for rows both won and closed this month; non-matching rows contribute 0. - revenue_this_quarter: sum of amount for rows both won and closed this quarter; non-matching rows contribute 0. Lead metrics (from leads excluding deleted records): - total_leads: count of all rows. - converted_leads: count of rows marked converted. - open_leads: count of rows not converted. - conversion_rate_pct: converted_leads divided by total_leads times 100, rounded to two decimals; when there are zero leads, the result is NULL. Account metrics (from accounts excluding deleted records): - total_accounts: count of all rows. - unique_account_owners: distinct count of owner_id. - unique_industries: distinct count of industry. - avg_company_size: average number_of_employees; ignores missing values. User metrics (from users, no deletion filter): - total_users: count of all rows. - active_users: count of rows marked active. Final assembly and calculated rates: - Cross join the single-row metrics above with the snapshot context to return exactly one row. - win_rate_pct: if total_opportunities > 0, won_opportunities divided by total_opportunities times 100, rounded to two decimals; otherwise 0. - close_rate_pct: if total_opportunities > 0, (won_opportunities + lost_opportunities) divided by total_opportunities times 100, rounded to two decimals; otherwise 0. Null and empty-set behavior: - Counts return 0 when there are no rows; conditional counts include only rows where the condition is true. - Conditional sums treat non-matching rows as zero; if the table has no rows, these sums are NULL. - Plain sums return NULL when there are no rows or all amounts are missing; averages ignore missing values and return NULL when no qualifying rows exist. - Percentage metrics are rounded to two decimals; currency amounts retain two-decimal scale.'

Opportunity metrics (from opportunities excluding deleted records): - total_opportunities: count of all rows. - won_opportunities: count of rows marked won. - lost_opportunities: count of rows closed and not won. - open_opportunities: count of rows not closed. - total_opportunity_value: sum of amount across all rows. - won_amount: sum of amount for won rows; non-matching rows contribute 0. - lost_amount: sum of amount for closed-not-won rows; non-matching rows contribute 0. - pipeline_amount: sum of amount for open (not closed) rows; non-matching rows contribute 0. - avg_days_to_close: average days_to_close over closed rows; ignores missing values. - avg_won_deal_size: average amount over won rows; ignores missing values. - opportunities_created_this_month: count of rows created this month. - opportunities_created_this_quarter: count of rows created this quarter. - opportunities_won_this_month: count of rows both won and closed this month. - opportunities_won_this_quarter: count of rows both won and closed this quarter. - pipeline_created_this_month: sum of amount for rows created this month; non-matching rows contribute 0. - pipeline_created_this_quarter: sum of amount for rows created this quarter; non-matching rows contribute 0. - revenue_this_month: sum of amount for rows both won and closed this month; non-matching rows contribute 0. - revenue_this_quarter: sum of amount for rows both won and closed this quarter; non-matching rows contribute 0. Lead metrics (from leads excluding deleted records): - total_leads: count of all rows. - converted_leads: count of rows marked converted. - open_leads: count of rows not converted. - conversion_rate_pct: converted_leads divided by total_leads times 100, rounded to two decimals; when there are zero leads, the result is NULL. Account metrics (from accounts excluding deleted records): - total_accounts: count of all rows. - unique_account_owners: distinct count of owner_id. - unique_industries: distinct count of industry. - avg_company_size: average number_of_employees; ignores missing values. User metrics (from users, no deletion filter): - total_users: count of all rows. - active_users: count of rows marked active. Final assembly and calculated rates: - Cross join the single-row metrics above with the snapshot context to return exactly one row. - win_rate_pct: if total_opportunities > 0, won_opportunities divided by total_opportunities times 100, rounded to two decimals; otherwise 0. - close_rate_pct: if total_opportunities > 0, (won_opportunities + lost_opportunities) divided by total_opportunities times 100, rounded to two decimals; otherwise 0. Null and empty-set behavior: - Counts return 0 when there are no rows; conditional counts include only rows where the condition is true. - Conditional sums treat non-matching rows as zero; if the table has no rows, these sums are NULL. - Plain sums return NULL when there are no rows or all amounts are missing; averages ignore missing values and return NULL when no qualifying rows exist. - Percentage metrics are rounded to two decimals; currency amounts retain two-decimal scale.

with revenue_by_owner as (
 select owner_id,sum(won_revenue) as total_revenue_won,
 count(*) filter(where is_won is true) as deals_won,
 avg(sales_cycle_days) filter(where is_won is true) as avg_sales_cycle_days,
 sum(won_revenue) filter(where is_current_quarter) as revenue_current_quarter,
 sum(won_revenue) filter(where is_previous_quarter) as revenue_previous_quarter,
 count(*) filter(where is_won is true and is_current_quarter) as deals_current_quarter
 from marts.salesforce__revenue_analytics group by owner_id
),
member_metrics as (
 select d.user_id,d.full_name,d.manager_id,d.manager_name,d.user_type,d.is_active,d.performance_tier,d.user_tenure_days,d.user_tenure_category,
 p.total_opportunities,p.won_opportunities,p.total_won_amount,p.total_pipeline_amount,p.win_rate_percentage,p.total_leads,p.converted_leads,
 p.total_activities,p.activity_completion_rate_percentage,r.total_revenue_won,r.deals_won,r.avg_sales_cycle_days,r.revenue_current_quarter,r.revenue_previous_quarter,r.deals_current_quarter
 from marts.dim_salesforce__user d
 left join intermediate.int_salesforce__user_performance p on d.user_id=p.user_id
 left join revenue_by_owner r on d.user_id=r.owner_id
 where d.is_active=true
),
team_rollup as (
 select coalesce(manager_id,'No Manager') as team_manager_id,coalesce(manager_name,'No Manager') as team_manager_name,user_type as team_type,
 count(distinct user_id) as team_size,count(distinct user_id) filter(where is_active) as active_team_members,
 count(distinct user_id) filter(where performance_tier='High Performer') as high_performers,
 count(distinct user_id) filter(where performance_tier='Good Performer') as good_performers,
 count(distinct user_id) filter(where performance_tier='Developing') as developing_performers,
 count(distinct user_id) filter(where performance_tier='New User') as new_users,
 sum(total_opportunities) as team_total_opportunities,sum(won_opportunities) as team_won_opportunities,
 sum(total_revenue_won) as team_total_revenue,sum(total_pipeline_amount) as team_total_pipeline,
 avg(total_opportunities) as avg_opportunities_per_member,avg(won_opportunities) as avg_wins_per_member,
 round(avg(total_revenue_won)) as avg_revenue_per_member,round(avg(win_rate_percentage),2) as avg_win_rate_per_member,
 sum(total_leads) as team_total_leads,sum(converted_leads) as team_converted_leads,sum(total_activities) as team_total_activities,
 round(avg(activity_completion_rate_percentage),2) as avg_activity_completion_rate,
 sum(revenue_current_quarter) as team_revenue_current_quarter,sum(deals_current_quarter) as team_deals_current_quarter,
 sum(revenue_previous_quarter) as team_revenue_previous_quarter,
 case when sum(team_total_opportunities) over(partition by coalesce(manager_id,'No Manager'),coalesce(manager_name,'No Manager'),user_type)>0 then 0 end as unused_placeholder,
 round(avg(user_tenure_days)) as avg_team_tenure_days,
 count(distinct user_id) filter(where user_tenure_category='New User') as new_team_members,
 count(distinct user_id) filter(where user_tenure_category='Veteran') as veteran_team_members
 from member_metrics group by manager_id,manager_name,user_type
),
performer_names as (
 select coalesce(manager_id,'No Manager') as team_manager_id,coalesce(manager_name,'No Manager') as team_manager_name,user_type as team_type,
 arg_max(full_name,total_revenue_won) filter(where total_revenue_won is not null) as top_revenue_performer,
 arg_max(full_name,win_rate_percentage) filter(where win_rate_percentage is not null) as top_win_rate_performer
 from member_metrics group by manager_id,manager_name,user_type
),
scored as (
 select t.*,pn.top_revenue_performer,pn.top_win_rate_performer,
 case when team_total_opportunities>0 then round(team_won_opportunities::double/team_total_opportunities*100,2) else 0.0 end as team_win_rate_percentage,
 case when team_total_leads>0 then round(team_converted_leads::double/team_total_leads*100,2) else 0.0 end as team_lead_conversion_rate,
 case when team_revenue_previous_quarter>0 then round((team_revenue_current_quarter-team_revenue_previous_quarter)::double/team_revenue_previous_quarter*100,2) end as revenue_growth_qoq_percentage,
 case when team_total_activities>0 and team_won_opportunities>0 then round(team_total_activities::double/team_won_opportunities,2) end as team_activities_per_win_ratio
 from team_rollup t left join performer_names pn using(team_manager_id,team_manager_name,team_type)
),
final_scores as (
 select *,least(100.0,greatest(0.0,
 least(team_win_rate_percentage,25)
 + case when team_size>0 and high_performers::double/team_size>=0.3 then 25 when team_size>0 and high_performers::double/team_size>=0.1 then 15 else 5 end
 + case when coalesce(avg_activity_completion_rate,0)>=80 then 20 when coalesce(avg_activity_completion_rate,0)>=60 then 15 else 10 end
 + case when coalesce(revenue_growth_qoq_percentage,0)>10 then 20 when coalesce(revenue_growth_qoq_percentage,0)>0 then 15 when coalesce(revenue_growth_qoq_percentage,0)>=-10 then 10 else 5 end
 + case when coalesce(team_lead_conversion_rate,0)>=20 then 10 when coalesce(team_lead_conversion_rate,0)>=10 then 7 else 3 end))::double as team_health_score
 from scored
)
select team_manager_id,team_manager_name,team_type,team_size,active_team_members,high_performers,good_performers,developing_performers,new_users,
 case when team_win_rate_percentage>=30 and avg_revenue_per_member>=100000 and high_performers>=2 then 'High Performing Team'
 when team_win_rate_percentage>=20 and avg_revenue_per_member>=50000 and high_performers+good_performers>=team_size/2.0 then 'Good Performing Team'
 when team_win_rate_percentage>=10 and avg_revenue_per_member>=25000 then 'Developing Team' else 'Needs Improvement' end as team_performance_tier,
 team_health_score,
 case when team_size>=5 and high_performers>=1 and good_performers>=1 and developing_performers>=1 then 'High Diversity'
 when team_size>=3 and (high_performers>=1 or good_performers>=1) and developing_performers>=1 then 'Medium Diversity'
 when team_size>=2 then 'Low Diversity' else 'Single Member' end as team_diversity_level,
 team_total_opportunities,team_won_opportunities,team_win_rate_percentage,team_total_revenue,team_total_pipeline,round(avg_opportunities_per_member,1) as avg_opportunities_per_member,
 round(avg_wins_per_member,1) as avg_wins_per_member,avg_revenue_per_member,avg_win_rate_per_member,team_total_leads,team_converted_leads,team_lead_conversion_rate,
 team_total_activities,avg_activity_completion_rate,team_revenue_current_quarter,team_deals_current_quarter,revenue_growth_qoq_percentage,team_activities_per_win_ratio,
 top_revenue_performer,top_win_rate_performer,avg_team_tenure_days,new_team_members,veteran_team_members
from final_scores order by team_health_score desc,team_total_revenue desc

      - intermediate.int_salesforce__user_performance
      - marts.dim_salesforce__user
      - marts.salesforce__revenue_analytics
      business_logic: '- Create user_performance from intermediate.int_salesforce__user_performance and user_dimension from marts.dim_salesforce__user. - From marts.salesforce__revenue_analytics, aggregate per owner_id: total revenue won (sum of won_revenue), deals won (count of rows where won), average sales cycle (average days on won deals), current-quarter won revenue (sum where in current quarter), previous-quarter won revenue (sum where in previous quarter), and current-quarter deals won (count of won deals in current quarter). - Join user_dimension to user_performance on user_id (left join), and to revenue_data on user_id = owner_id (left join). Keep only rows where the user is active, then group by: • team_manager_id = manager_id with nulls replaced by "No Manager" • team_manager_name = manager_name with nulls replaced by "No Manager" • team_type = user_type (can be null) - For each group, compute: • team_size = distinct count of users • active_team_members = distinct count of users where active (equals team_size under the active-user filter) • high_performers, good_performers, developing_performers, new_users = distinct user counts by performance_tier exact match • team_total_opportunities and team_won_opportunities = sums across users • team_total_revenue and team_total_pipeline = sums of revenue and pipeline amounts • team_win_rate_percentage = 100 × (total won opportunities ÷ total opportunities), rounded to two decimals; return 0 if total opportunities is zero or null • avg_opportunities_per_member and avg_wins_per_member = per-user averages, rounded to one decimal; nulls excluded • avg_revenue_per_member = per-user average revenue won, rounded to the nearest whole unit; nulls excluded • avg_win_rate_per_member = per-user average win rate percentage, rounded to two decimals; nulls excluded • team_total_leads and team_converted_leads = sums across users • team_lead_conversion_rate = 100 × (converted leads ÷ total leads), rounded to two decimals; return 0 if total leads is zero or null • team_total_activities = sum across users; avg_activity_completion_rate = per-user average completion rate percentage, rounded to two decimals; nulls excluded • team_revenue_current_quarter and team_deals_current_quarter = sums of current-quarter revenue and deals from revenue_data • revenue_growth_qoq_percentage = 100 × (current-quarter revenue minus previous-quarter revenue) ÷ previous-quarter revenue, rounded to two decimals; null if previous-quarter revenue is zero or null • team_activities_per_win_ratio = total activities ÷ total won opportunities, rounded to two decimals; null unless both totals are greater than zero • top_revenue_performer = the full_name of the member with the highest total won amount; members without a value are ranked last; ties are arbitrary • top_win_rate_performer = the full_name of the member with the highest win rate percentage; members without a value are ranked last; ties are arbitrary • avg_team_tenure_days = average user tenure in days, rounded to the nearest whole day; nulls excluded • new_team_members and veteran_team_members = distinct user counts where user_tenure_category is "New User" or "Veteran" - Enhance with: • team_performance_tier: - High Performing Team: win rate ≥ 30, average revenue per member ≥ 100,000, and at least 2 high performers - Good Performing Team: win rate ≥ 20, average revenue per member ≥ 50,000, and high + good performers cover at least half of the team - Developing Team: win rate ≥ 10 and average revenue per member ≥ 25,000 - Otherwise: Needs Improvement • team_health_score = sum of five components, clipped to the 0–100 range: - Win rate contribution: the win rate capped at 25 - High-performer share: 25 if high performers ÷ team_size ≥ 0.3, else 15 if ≥ 0.1, else 5 (when team_size is 0, this defaults to 5) - Activity completion: 20 if ≥ 80%, else 15 if ≥ 60%, else 10 - Revenue growth: 20 if > 10%, else 15 if > 0%, else 10 if ≥ -10%, else 5 - Lead conversion: 10 if ≥ 20%, else 7 if ≥ 10%, else 3 • team_diversity_level: - High Diversity: team_size ≥ 5 and at least one high, one good, and one developing performer - Medium Diversity: team_size ≥ 3 and at least one high or good performer and at least one developing performer - Low Diversity: team_size ≥ 2 - Otherwise: Single Member - Output all fields from the enhanced dataset; final ordering is by team_health_score descending, then team_total_revenue descending.'

specification.grain: One row per team_manager_id + team_manager_name + team_type
specification.business_logic: - Create user_performance from intermediate.int_salesforce__user_performance and user_dimension from marts.dim_salesforce__user. - From marts.salesforce__revenue_analytics, aggregate per owner_id: total revenue won (sum of won_revenue), deals won (count of rows where won), average sales cycle (average days on won deals), current-quarter won revenue (sum where in current quarter), previous-quarter won revenue (sum where in previous quarter), and current-quarter deals won (count of won deals in current quarter). - Join user_dimension to user_performance on user_id (left join), and to revenue_data on user_id = owner_id (left join). Keep only rows where the user is active, then group by: • team_manager_id = manager_id with nulls replaced by "No Manager" • team_manager_name = manager_name with nulls replaced by "No Manager" • team_type = user_type (can be null) - For each group, compute: • team_size = distinct count of users • active_team_members = distinct count of users where active (equals team_size under the active-user filter) • high_performers, good_performers, developing_performers, new_users = distinct user counts by performance_tier exact match • team_total_opportunities and team_won_opportunities = sums across users • team_total_revenue and team_total_pipeline = sums of revenue and pipeline amounts • team_win_rate_percentage = 100 × (total won opportunities ÷ total opportunities), rounded to two decimals; return 0 if total opportunities is zero or null • avg_opportunities_per_member and avg_wins_per_member = per-user averages, rounded to one decimal; nulls excluded • avg_revenue_per_member = per-user average revenue won, rounded to the nearest whole unit; nulls excluded • avg_win_rate_per_member = per-user average win rate percentage, rounded to two decimals; nulls excluded • team_total_leads and team_converted_leads = sums across users • team_lead_conversion_rate = 100 × (converted leads ÷ total leads), rounded to two decimals; return 0 if total leads is zero or null • team_total_activities = sum across users; avg_activity_completion_rate = per-user average completion rate percentage, rounded to two decimals; nulls excluded • team_revenue_current_quarter and team_deals_current_quarter = sums of current-quarter revenue and deals from revenue_data • revenue_growth_qoq_percentage = 100 × (current-quarter revenue minus previous-quarter revenue) ÷ previous-quarter revenue, rounded to two decimals; null if previous-quarter revenue is zero or null • team_activities_per_win_ratio = total activities ÷ total won opportunities, rounded to two decimals; null unless both totals are greater than zero • top_revenue_performer = the full_name of the member with the highest total won amount; members without a value are ranked last; ties are arbitrary • top_win_rate_performer = the full_name of the member with the highest win rate percentage; members without a value are ranked last; ties are arbitrary • avg_team_tenure_days = average user tenure in days, rounded to the nearest whole day; nulls excluded • new_team_members and veteran_team_members = distinct user counts where user_tenure_category is "New User" or "Veteran" - Enhance with: • team_performance_tier: - High Performing Team: win rate ≥ 30, average revenue per member ≥ 100,000, and at least 2 high performers - Good Performing Team: win rate ≥ 20, average revenue per member ≥ 50,000, and high + good performers cover at least half of the team - Developing Team: win rate ≥ 10 and average revenue per member ≥ 25,000 - Otherwise: Needs Improvement • team_health_score = sum of five components, clipped to the 0–100 range: - Win rate contribution: the win rate capped at 25 - High-performer share: 25 if high performers ÷ team_size ≥ 0.3, else 15 if ≥ 0.1, else 5 (when team_size is 0, this defaults to 5) - Activity completion: 20 if ≥ 80%, else 15 if ≥ 60%, else 10 - Revenue growth: 20 if > 10%, else 15 if > 0%, else 10 if ≥ -10%, else 5 - Lead conversion: 10 if ≥ 20%, else 7 if ≥ 10%, else 3 • team_diversity_level: - High Diversity: team_size ≥ 5 and at least one high, one good, and one developing performer - Medium Diversity: team_size ≥ 3 and at least one high or good performer and at least one developing performer - Low Diversity: team_size ≥ 2 - Otherwise: Single Member - Output all fields from the enhanced dataset; final ordering is by team_health_score descending, then team_total_revenue descending.

columns.name: team_manager_id
columns.description: Manager identifier for the team with nulls replaced by 'No Manager'.

columns.name: team_manager_name
columns.description: Manager full name with nulls replaced by 'No Manager'.

columns.name: team_type
columns.description: Team type from user_type; can be null and is part of the grouping.

columns.name: team_size
columns.description: Distinct count of active users in the team after filtering to active users.

columns.name: active_team_members
columns.description: Distinct count of active users; equals team_size under the active-user filter.

columns.name: high_performers
columns.description: Distinct user count with performance_tier equal to 'High Performer'.

columns.name: good_performers
columns.description: Distinct user count with performance_tier equal to 'Good Performer'.

columns.name: developing_performers
columns.description: Distinct user count with performance_tier equal to 'Developing'.

columns.name: new_users
columns.description: Distinct user count with performance_tier equal to 'New User'.

columns.name: team_performance_tier
columns.description: Team tier based on win rate, average revenue per member, and performer mix thresholds.

columns.name: team_health_score
columns.description: Composite score from five components capped between 0 and 100.

columns.name: team_diversity_level
columns.description: Diversity category based on team size and presence across performance tiers.

columns.name: team_total_opportunities
columns.description: Total opportunities summed across team; nulls ignored and result is null if all inputs are null.

columns.description: Total won opportunities summed across team; nulls ignored and result is null if all inputs are null.
